name: Relâmpago - [MMMM]
description:
They say Relâmpago never strikes the same place twice, but ask any poor soul who's gone up against a Wizard with the Relâmpago Bolt spell...that's just a flagrant lie. Relâmpago Dano can seize muscles, Dano the heart, and even alter the brain. When treating Relâmpago Dano, always remember to look for the electricity's entry and exit point...after you are
completely certain the patient is grounded, of course.

results.description:
A eletricidade surge no âmago do seu ser, fazendo com que seu coração gagueje. É muito mais difícil para você lidar com a atividade física sem ficar muito cansado. Sempre que você fizer níveis de eReferência[exaustão]{exaustão} , você faz um nível adicional.

Tratamento - A DC 25 Cirurgia Geral.
results.name: Arritmia cardíaca

results.description:
Quando a eletricidade sai do seu coração, ela bate uma última vez antes do silêncio. Você está &Referência[inconsciente]{inconsciente} e morrendo, seus pontos de vida caem para 0.

Tratamento - Se você está estabilizado, seu coração galopa de volta à vida, você não está mais __ X7X __ inconsciente __ X8X __ , e seus pontos de vida retornam ao total em que estavam antes de caírem para 0.
results.name: Parada Cardíaca

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.iP8lOROAIYARwcgk]{Tabela de Membros Grandes}. Your muscle has contracted so strongly that its been torn free of the bone. Your limb is sem funcionamento and will not properly heal without Cirurgia.

Tratamento - A DC 20 Teste de Resistência Cirurgia de Membro.
results.name: Muscle Avulsion

results.description:
Your brain has been Danod by the electrical surge and you're not acting like yourself. Você sofre a flaw chosen randomly or by the DM.

Tratamento - After each Long Rest roll a d20. On a 19 or 20, the flaw disappears.
results.name: Personality Change

results.description: Your muscles twitch in repetitive patterns and you have difficulty coordinating your movement. You have disadvantage on all Dexterity based attacks, checks, and saves for [[1d4]] turns.
results.name: Muscle Spasms

results.description:
Your muscles seize, your eyes roll back, and you cannot seem to Força your body to function. You are &Reference[paralyzed]{paralyzed} until the end of your next turn. Critical hits as the result of your paralysis do not cause you to roll another Lesão Persistente.

Tratamento - The Lesser Restoration spell removes this paralysis as usual.
results.name: Electrocution

results.description:
Your body convulses and seizes, you can hardly even think, much less move it. You are &Reference[paralyzed]{paralyzed} for [[1d2]] rounds. Critical hits as the result of your paralysis do not cause you to roll another Lesão Persistente.

Tratamento - The Lesser Restoration spell removes this paralysis as usual.
results.name: True Electrocution

results.description:
Your nerves are shot, you feel numb, and you're having trouble making your body respond with the speed you need it to. Você não pode take reactions for [[1d4]] days.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 14]] check reduces the duration of this injury by [[1d4]] days.
results.name: Numbed Nerves

results.description: Role duas vezes na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{Tabela de Cicatrizes}. Each area of your body is left with a round scar, one where the electricity entered, and one where the electricity left.
results.name: Aterramento Cicatriz

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{Tabela de Cicatrizes}. This area of your body is left with a Lichtenberg Figure, a scar resembling Relâmpago that runs along the path the current took through your body.
results.name: Lichtenberg Figure

results.description:
__X0X __ A corrente elétrica incendiou você. No início do seu turno, você sofre dano de incêndio dimensionado para o dano que causou o ferimento persistente: 1-10 dano ( [[1d2]] ), 11-20 dano ( [[1d4]] ), 21-30 dano ( [[1d6]] ), 31-40 dano ( __ X4X __ ), __ X5X __ 40 dano ( [[1d10]] ).

Tratamento - Você pode usar uma ação para extinguir as chamas.
results.name: Arco Elétrico

results.description: The electricity crackles around your body for a second, looking for the closest thing to discharge to. The electricity then arcs from you to the nearest creature carrying metal weapons or wearing metal armor. This creature takes Relâmpago Dano equal to half the Dano that caused the Lesão Persistente.
results.name: Relâmpago Rod

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{Tabela de Cicatrizes}. In a freak instance of chance, the electricity has interacted with a thread of natural magic within you. This body part emits a small electrical arc of energy every few minutes. If you use an action to touch this body part to a character with 0 Hit Points they become stable in the same manner as the Spare the Dying cantrip. You may suppress the arcing effect by maintaining Concentração. The limb emits a faint aura of Evocation.
results.name: Static Arco

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.vG8gsjqxGB7y9cSD]{Tabela de Apêndices Pequenos}. The electricity has violently exited your body at this point, charring it to the point of being sem funcionamento . Se não for tratado dentro de 24 horas, the appendage will necrotize and fall off in [[1d4]] days (after which it is ausente ).

Tratamento - A DC 21 Teste de Resistência Cirurgia de Membro.
results.name: Destructive Aterramento

results.description:
Shocked through the heart, and you're to blame. Any time you are &Reference[charmed]{charmed} or &Reference[frightened]{frightened} you take 1 level of &Reference[exhaustion]{exhaustion} .

Tratamento - A DC 25 Cirurgia Geral.
results.name: Heart Palpitations

results.description: A eletricidade atravessa a fiação do seu cérebro, causando curto-circuito em seus neurônios e mudando você permanentemente. Seu alinhamento muda um passo para neutro no eixo lei/caos. Se já estiver neutro, trate este teste como um 15.
results.name: Lesão cerebral
